name: Animal Parade
desc: A mixed procession of storybook animals — ducks, dogs, cats and an elephant — plodding across the page and thumping down together on every beat.

scale.doc: per-animal size vs design (each ~0.22*min-dim tall at 1)

n.doc: number of animals in the procession

hue.doc: palette anchor hue (30 = warm earthy gouache)

stomp.doc: collective beat-stomp dip + dust puff strength

x.doc: line center x (unused for wrap, kept for contract)

seed.doc: deterministic species mix / depth / jitter seed

style.doc: render philosophy: textured gouache / carved linocut / cut-paper silhouette / chalkboard line / 2-ink print

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: steady parade / slow amble / fast stomping stampede
